verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a general REST API and CLI for managing resources, plus docs pages on machine types and regional availability. Nothing shows a documented endpoint that returns the GPU catalog with live pricing and availability for programmatic querying before spending. The availability page is static documentation, and the pricing page shows no machine-readable rates.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the GPU catalog with live pricing and availability from a public or documented endpoint before committing any spend
